identification: Malformed opaque PE32 GUI image; original product undetermined
reason: No concrete hostile behavior established; the ordinary startup path faults before imported APIs are called. BENIGN is an evidence-standard verdict, not an attribution of the opaque bytes to a trusted program.

reverse_engineering.effect: The unguarded memory access can fault earlier; even with that access mapped, STI at 0x434d6e raises #GP in a normal CPL3 Windows process. There is no intervening branch, API call or exception registration.
reverse_engineering.alternate_initializers: TLS, exception and load-config directory entries are all absent; the image is an EXE with no exports.
reverse_engineering.emulation: Unicorn x86-32: mapped image and stack, EDI points at mapped writable .k0, EAX zero. Instruction hook stops at STI, applying the CPL3 privilege rule explicitly because Unicorn is not a Windows loader.

.k2.content: KERNEL32 import directory and zero padding

reverse_engineering.unpacking: UPX refuses the modified/protected image. No executable decoder or usable key was recovered. Uniform opaque section content and a six-API import table do not establish an unpacker or any payload behavior.
reverse_engineering.identity: No version resources or product strings; the certificate claims a Chinese test signer, but the Authenticode digest mismatches, so it cannot authenticate this image.
reverse_engineering.urls: TrustAsia CRL and issuer-certificate URLs in the certificate table, with no traced request path.
reverse_engineering.limitations: Original contents and purpose of the opaque section remain unknown. No attribution to a malware family or a repair utility is justified.

retirement_reason: These co-occurrence profiles infer execution/concealment or hostility from ordinary imports and structural measurements. Keep their existing constituent observations; do not move an unsupported execution claim into a metadata profile.
migration_review: Section permission matchers and gates preserved exactly. Exact YAML consumers and active cases updated. No hardening ancestor selectors consume the source. No section/permission or section ancestor selectors consume the destination; the sole metadata/binary ancestor selector is a timing-rule downgrade already satisfied by other binary facts.
other_corrections: Short dotted section names are notable label/entry geometry, not evidence of a packer.
Writable entry plus stale PE checksum is a notable structural relationship.
URL-presence rules no longer map bare URL references to HTTP communication/C2.
LoadLibraryA and VirtualProtect descriptions identify symbol/import evidence.

controls.wx_section: Five positive permission fixtures match; near-miss-no-wx-section.exe does not.
controls.unrelated_existing_case_gap: The sparse-string UPX profile case does not match because its sparse-string constituent is suppressed by string-sparse-by-construction. All three required layout legs, including the relocated WX trait, match. No change to that suppression.

local_fixture_evidence.original_expectation_comment: Synthetic fixture (random payload, hand-built imports, transplanted expired test-cert blob that no longer matches the image).
local_fixture_evidence.corrected_expectations: BENIGN; no hostile; at most one suspicious; preserve digest mismatch and structural/import traits.
